chunks: Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Ahmad ibn 'Abd Allah al-Karkhi, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
I heard Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام saying: “One hajj is better than the world and all that is in it, and one obligatory salat (prayer) is better than a thousand hajj pilgrimages.”

key_terms.أَلْفِ: one thousand, indicating vast multiplicative merit
key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: the worldly life and its entire value

ai.seo_question: Which is more virtuous in Islam: hajj or the obligatory salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense virtue of acts of worship, especially hajj and the obligatory salat (prayer). It teaches that while hajj has tremendous merit, a single obligatory salat (prayer) holds an even greater rank, highlighting the centrality of daily prescribed worship.
